The given repeating decimal can be written as 

$$
0.\overline{23} = 0.23 + 0.002\,3 + 0.000\,023 + \dots
$$

$$
0.\overline{23} = \dfrac{23}{100} + \dfrac{23}{10\,000} + \dfrac{23}{1\,000\,000}+\dots
$$

where the first term is $a_1 = \dfrac{23}{100}$ and the common ratio is $\dfrac{1}{100}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}0.\overset{―}{23} & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{23}{100}\cdot {(\frac{1}{100})}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }23\cdot \frac{1}{100}\cdot {(\frac{1}{100})}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }23\cdot \frac{1}{100}\cdot {(\frac{1}{100})}^{n}\cdot {(\frac{1}{100})}^{-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }23{(\frac{1}{100})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
